models.name: pinterest_ads__ad_group_report
models.description: Each record in this table represents the daily performance of ads at the campaign, advertiser, and ad group level.

columns.name: date_day
columns.description: The performance date of the record.

columns.name: advertiser_name
columns.description: Name of the advertiser.

columns.name: advertiser_id
columns.description: The ID of the related Advertiser.

columns.name: campaign_name
columns.description: The name of the related Campaign.

columns.name: campaign_status
columns.description: Status of the campaign.

columns.name: campaign_id
columns.description: The ID of the related Campaign.

columns.name: ad_group_name
columns.description: The name of the related Ad group.

columns.name: ad_group_id
columns.description: The ID of the related Ad group.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Ad group creation time.

columns.name: start_time
columns.description: Ad group start time.

columns.name: end_time
columns.description: Ad group end time.

columns.name: ad_group_status
columns.description: Status of the ad group.

columns.name: spend
columns.description: The amount of spend that occurred on the day of the record. Convert the unit to dollars. Set to 0 if the value is NULL.

columns.name: clicks
columns.description: The number of paid and earned clicks that occurred on the day of the record. Set to 0 if the value is NULL.

columns.name: impressions
columns.description: The number of paid and earned impressions that occurred on the day of the record. Set to 0 if the value is NULL.

columns.name: total_conversions
columns.description: This is the sum of all website conversions, otherwise known as the number of conversion events. For example, if you track sign-ups and checkouts on your website, it's the sum of all sign-ups and checkouts attributed from clicks, engagements, and views on Pinterest. Example, If a user clicks on a Pinterest ad and completes two different conversion actions (e.g., signs up and checks out), this would be counted as 2 total conversions. Set to 0 if the value is NULL.

columns.name: total_conversions_quantity
columns.description: Refers to the total count of items or units involved in the conversions. This metric is often more granular and relates to the specific quantity of products or services purchased or actions taken. Example, If a single checkout includes three items, the total_conversions_quantity would be 3, even though it counts as one total_conversion. Set to 0 if the value is NULL.

columns.name: total_conversions_value
columns.description: Total conversions order value. The total value of the conversions, calculated by summing up the revenue or order values attributed to conversions. Converted from the source total_conversions_value_in_micro_dollar field. Convert the unit to dollars. Set to 0 if the value is NULL.
